desc: Ideation: identify candidate approaches (internal-zero crossing, ordered-token median, convex minimization).

Implement the O(N) internal-zero crossing solution in Python: read N and S from stdin, compute k = S.count('1'), scan S while maintaining ones_seen, and for every '0' with 0 < ones_seen < k add min(ones_seen, k - ones_seen) to ans; print ans.
Verify edge cases: k = 1, already contiguous, ones at string boundaries, large N, and confirm O(N) time with O(1) extra memory.

Fallback if the internal-zero method fails: implement ordered-token median method (positions p, q[i]=p[i]-i, median q[k//2], answer=sum(abs(q[i]-median))) or discrete convex minimization over block starts.
